# searchstax_account_backup (Resource)

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `backup_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import an existing account backup with `account_name/backup_id`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_account_backup.example account_name/backup_id
```
